entities.name: Yuberjén Martínez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yurberjen Herney Martínez Rivas is a Colombian boxer. He won a silver medal in the light flyweight division at the 2016 Summer Olympics. In June 2021, he qualified to represent Colombia at the 2020 Summer Olympics; he decided that that would be the last Olympiad of his career.
